relevant_body_lines.text: | - | Soak retry (RL-171; Mythos #794 F3): `soak_attempts` printed per span; a refused soak then an accepted retry is not a stop; no accepted soak is a REFUSAL | `check_soak`, `_retried_soak` (`DESK_ATTEMPTS` on a record that disagrees with its stages) | `test_no_retry_prints_one_accepted_soak`, `test_a_refused_soak_then_an_accepted_retry_is_not_a_stopped_span`, `test_a_second_soak_refusal_is_a_stop` |

| **Mythos F3 / Sol 13** (HIGH/MED): false REFUSAL on development-pin receipts | No `soak_attempts` field plus exactly one `soak` stage with rc 0 is one accepted soak. A `soak.a<k>` stage without the field is `DESK_ATTEMPTS` | `LegacyPins`, on the **pinned runners' own mocks** at `b4b6aeb19` (cl-dev-02) and `2d347f721` (cl-dev-04), committed as fixtures; a test regenerates them from the pins when they are in the clone |

| **Sol 7** (HIGH): a hand table with no measurements "agrees" | Every row must carry every comparable field (`attempts`, `contaminated_redos`, `g0_outcome`, `g0_s`, `wall_s`, `band_reached`, `admitted`, plus `g0_role` and `span_reference` on v1.1), with `named_stops` and `soak_attempts` at the top. A missing, duplicate, mistyped or non-finite field is `HAND_TABLE_INVALID`, which holds the next arm | `IncompleteHandTable` (2 tests) |

| **Sol 8 / Mythos F6**: a retried soak does not trigger the hand table; the refusal kind is lost | A retried soak is a mandatory hand-table trigger (RL-172a). The refusal text and kind (`slope`, `load`, `settle_or_quiet`) go into `desk_summary.json` and the Q1 print | `test_a_refused_soak_then_an_accepted_retry_is_not_a_stopped_span` |

| **Sol 9** (HIGH): an error receipt or failed restore certifies | Each of these is a REFUSAL with a hold: a non-zero receipt rc or an error, a missing or failed restore (a missing restore is also `DESK_SCHEMA`), any failed stage (except a retried soak and the non-fatal `display`), or a transition status other than CLOSED_OK. An accepted soak needs its stage with rc 0. A span result that contradicts the rc is `DESK_SCHEMA` | `CommandResults` (4 tests) |
